rdf:Description.rdfs:label: System Package Data Exchange™ (SPDX®) Ontology
rdf:Description.dcterms:abstract: This ontology defines the terms and relationships used in the SPDX specification to describe system packages
rdf:Description.dcterms:creator: SPDX Project
rdf:Description.dcterms:title: System Package Data Exchange (SPDX) Ontology

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment:
**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/intendedUse](../../Core/Properties/intendedUse.md) instead.
The intended use of a given dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: recording
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Captured datastream like audio, video, or any other kind of continuous electronic capture of events, behavior or conditions.
ResponsibilityChangeAction refers to the transfer of responsibility from one party to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dependsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Describes a relationship between one or more elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: syntactic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such as a parse tree used for natural language processing.
This individual element was defined by the spec.
A prescribed change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasInstance
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Software/AbstractPackage has more specific instances that are the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a bill of materials.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDynamicLink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element dynamically links in each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for support.
Information about the relationship between two Elements.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is serializedInArtifact, from must be a SpdxDocument

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssessmentFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security assessment. The use of the `hasAssessmentFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: certificationReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a certification report for a package from an accredited/independent body.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityThreatModel
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the [security threat model](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Threat_model) for the package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
Abstract class for additional text intended to be added to a License, but which is not itself a standalone License.
Specifies the version of a VEX statement.
A physical location is a tangible, geographically identifiable place where objects, people, or assets exist or operate.
A Package that contains a dataset.
Energy quantity.
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.
An assertion made in relation to one or more elements.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is hasRoleIn, class must be RoleRelationship

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Points to a resource outside the scope of the SPDX 3 content that provides additional characteristics of an Element.
Provides a NamespaceMap of prefixes and associated namespace partial URIs applicable to an SpdxDocument and independent of any specific serialization format or instance.
This class represents the process involved in manufacturing products.
Provide consumers with comments by the creator of the Element about the Element.
EvidenceRelationship defines the association between pieces of evidence and EvaluationResult.
Provides information about the completeness of relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: copiedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been copied to each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conformsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element conforms to each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption or Specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: functionalSafety
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the FunctionalSafety profile specification.
Specifies the type of the external reference.
Harvest is the process of extracting goods or products from nature.
Impact justification label to be used when linking a vulnerability to an element representing a VEX product with a VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issueTracker
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the issue tracker for a package.
Describes the type of annotation.
A license addition that is not listed on the SPDX Exceptions List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasSpecification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a specification for the `from` Element (`from` hasSpecification `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
A container for a grouping of SPDX 3 content characterizing details (provenance, composition, licensing, etc.) about a product.
An SPDX version 2.X compatible verification method for software packages.
A license that is not listed on the SPDX License List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.
EvaluationResult is the result of an evaluation.
Unit in which energy is measured.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.
The name of a standard applicable to an artifact.
CreateAction represents an event of product creation.
Describes how an Agent provides support for an Artifact.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is tracedToDetail, from must be a Requirement
https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's design.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.
This is the individual, business, or organization who currently manages or responsible for the goods, services, or assets.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).
Provides a numerical (0-10) representation of the severity of a vulnerability.
Specifies whether the License is listed as free by the Free Software Foundation (FSF).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: observation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Documentation of direct monitoring or witnessing of the demonstration of processes, tests, or any kind of system responses during a specified timeframe under specified environmental conditions.
ManufactureAction represents the act of creating a product by a manufacturing process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other safety integrity level not covered above.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analysis
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Analytical evaluating of data, designs, or processes methodically to verify correctness against standards or expectations. Typical analysis methods are FMEA, FTA, STPA, static analysis for MISRA compliance etc.
Protocols which support PKI key validation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iscc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Content Code (ISCC)](https://iscc.io/) is a content-derived identifier standardized by [ISO 24138](https://www.iso.org/standard/77899.html) for identifying digital assets. ISCC can be used in conjunction with other schemes, such as DOI, ISAN, ISBN, ISRC, ISSN and ISWC. A standard ISCC-CODE is build from multiple ISCC-UNITs. Each unit serve a different purpose. An ISCC-CODE typically look like `ISCC:KACT4EBWK27737D2AYCJRAL5Z36G76RFRMO4554RU26HZ4ORJGIVHDI`.
Information about the AI software, not including the model description.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is verifiedBy, to must be a RequirementVerification

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/european-case-law-identifier-ecli) is a uniform identifier for judicial decisions across Europe. It consists of five mandatory components: the "ECLI" prefix, a country code, a court code, the year of the decision, and a unique serial number (e.g., `ECLI:EU:C:2023:94`).
Provides functional safety context for an existing lifecycle-scoped relationship.
A test action is a specific action associated with a test.
Results of general safety risk assessment of the AI system.
A collection of Elements, not necessarily with unifying context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) report.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: extension
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Extension profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deviceDriver
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents software that controls hardware devices.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endOfSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is a defined end of support for the artifact from the supplier. This may also be referred to as end of life. There is a validUntilDate that can be used to signal when support ends for the artifact.
Class that describes an action that has occurred.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is verifiedBy, from must be a Requirement

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The AssemblyProcess represents the process of creating a product by assembling a set of components, potentially in a way that allows for at disassembly (at least partially).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: critical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 9.0 - 10.0.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Natural Location Identifier (NLI)](https://eccma.org/enli-eccma-natural-location-identifier/) is a 14- or 15-character alphanumeric string standardized by [ISO 8000-118](https://www.iso.org/standard/85428.html) that uniquely identifies a three-dimensional geographic point location. The identifier is generated from geodetic coordinates and elevation data. For electronic storage, the `ISO.NLI:` prefix shall be retained (e.g., `ISO.NLI:41TS8M-A8ELTQ-H2`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gtin
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin) is a number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a trade item (product or service).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during the execution phase of an element.
Agent represents anything with the potential to act on a system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: platform
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents a runtime environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is documentation.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is fixedIn, class must be VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Timestamp, when an assessment was conducted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crystalsKyber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Kyber](https://pq-crystals.org/kyber/)
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where all elements apply.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: any hashing algorithm that does not exist in this list of entries
Provides a CVSS version 4 assessment for a vulnerability.
A License participating in a 'with addition' model.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/version](../../Core/Properties/version.md) instead.
Identify the version of a package.
Class that describes an instance of Hardware.
Identifies a functional safety integrity level associated with a relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: createdBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Action or DefinedProcess is createdBy `to` Agent(s).
Abstract ancestor class for all VEX relationships.
A known location is specified at this time.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.
Process plans outline the stages of implementation or use related to a process.
ISO level of automation.
Class that describes a process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) statement which provides information on whether a product is impacted by a specific vulnerability in an included package and, if affected, whether there are actions recommended to remediate. See also [NTIA VEX one-page summary](https://ntia.gov/files/ntia/publications/vex_one-page_summary.pdf).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fullAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 5 - Full automation. The system is capable of performing its entire mission without external intervention.
Links a vulnerability and one or more elements designating the latter as products not affected by the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test artifact for the `from` Element (`from` hasTest `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is of a type not included in this list.
Refers to one or more Elements that are part of an ElementCollection.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eori
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/customs/customs-procedures-import-and-export/customs-operations/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-number-eori_en) is a unique identifier for businesses undertaking customs operations across European Union customs territory, such as import, export, and transit. It consists of an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code followed by a national identifier of up to 15 alphanumeric characters (e.g., `PL1234567890ABCDE`).
Class that describes a physical instance of Hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configures
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is a configuration applied to each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Records the storage of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: low
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Low/no risk is posed by an AI system.
Specifies the algorithm used for calculating the hash value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: validatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been validated on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is implementedBy, from must be a Requirement
When relationship is usesTool, class must be LifecycleScopedRelationship

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An individual human being.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: No assertion can be made about the completeness of the relationship.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is hasAssessmentFor, class must be VulnAssessmentRelationship

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The CreateProcess refers to the abstract process class that can be used to represent the process of creation of a product.
RequirementVerification class defines the base properties of a verification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Software profile specification.
Refers to any object that stores content on a computer.
The number that identifies a PO box. A PO box is a box in a post office or other postal service location assigned to an organization where postal items may be kept.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: no
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates absence of the field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: library
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software library.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, a Wikipedia article (without images), or a transcript.
The base class for actions performed by an agent that involve the use or handling of a product or element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software manifest.
Test Process defines the testing process for an element.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where only one of the elements applies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Unlimited. Subject to standard copyright rules, the dataset may be shared freely, without restriction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to metrics related to a package such as OpenSSF scorecards.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: No assertion about the type of support is made. This is considered the default if no other support type is used.
A PlanAction involves the execution of a plan in relation to a PlanProcess.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.
Identifies from where or whom the Element originally came.
This individual element was defined by the spec.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a License which has additional text applied to it.
The ProcessReadinessType is defined by the enumeration.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amberStrict
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Limited distribution - organization only. The dataset shall be shared only with specific organizations on a need-to-know basis.
Records if sensitive personal information is used during model training or could be used during the inference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: providesSupportFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent provides support for each `to` Artifact. The use of the `providesSupportFor` type is constrained to `SupportRelationship` classed relationships.
A map of Element identifiers that are used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.
Identifies the tooling that was used during the creation of the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Legislation Identifier (ELI)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/content/help/eurlex-content/eli.html) is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) that uniquely identifies a legal resource, typically consisting of a document type, adoption year, and document number (e.g., `http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: incomplete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known not to be exhaustive.
Connects a vulnerability and an element designating the element as a product affected by the vulnerability.
Defines the beginning of a range.
Specifies the time when a vulnerability was published.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is fixedIn, from must be a Vulnerability

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Sets the context for an assessment by specifying the related project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: attend
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, and may involve publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities sooner than standard update timelines.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exportControlAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an export control assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operatingSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an operating system.
A class that represents a measured quantity paired with a unit of measure from the QUDT ontology.
Provides an SSVC assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/ExpandedLicensing/ExtendableLicense is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Built-in inline controls or mitigations prevent an adversary from leveraging the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.
Artifact representing a serialization instance of SPDX data containing the definition of a particular Element.
Class that describes a build instance of software/artifacts.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as a reference within an organization's product catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: none
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is 0.0.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patch
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element contains a set of changes to update, fix, or improve another Element.
ResponsibilityChangeProcess refers to the process of transferring responsibility from one party to another.

rdf:Description.sh:message: A value for Core/name is required when a value for Core/version is present

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ownership
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Ownership refers to the legal right to control, manage, and benefit from an asset, resource, or responsibility. It establishes authority, accountability, and entitlements over something, whether it's property, a business, intellectual property, or responsibilities.
The assessment of the state of a requirement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: container
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a container image which can be used by a container runtime application.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is hasRequirement, class must be LifecycleScopedRelationship

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasUninstall
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has each `to` Artifact uninstalled (removed from position for use) from it during a LifecycleScopeType period. To express the Agent doing the uninstall, link this relationship as the `from` in `performedBy`.
A license exception that is listed on the SPDX Exceptions list.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: privacyAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a privacy assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha224
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 224, as defined in [RFC 3874](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3874/).
A state is an instance that describes what a system, component, subsystem, process, or project has achieved at any given time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.
Describes if a given file is a directory or non-directory kind of file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssociatedVulnerability
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to associate a `from` Artifact with each `to` /Security/Vulnerability.
A key used in a generic key-value pair.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: npm
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an npm package. The package locator format is defined in the [npm documentation](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/package-json) and looks like `package@version`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cycle
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation architectures with precise cycle-level accuracy.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence with an upper level requirement. Typically done as peer review, offline review or review meeting.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: compliance
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for compliance matters (i.e. export control, licensing).
References the Element on the left-hand side of a relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: categorical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data that is classified into a discrete number of categories, such as the eye color of a population of people.
Property that describes the digest of the build configuration file used to invoke a build.
A Package that contains AI software or an AI model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 6 - Autonomous. The system is capable of modifying its intended domain of use or its goals without external intervention, control or oversight.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement has been approved by stakeholder, and can be include in traceability.
A planned path used to move people, goods, data, or resources from one location to another.
Defines the original host file that the snippet information applies to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data type is not known.
A prescribed change to a product's location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element doesn't fit into any of the other categories.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition.
An Individual Value for License where the SPDX data creator determines that no license is present.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assistiveAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 1 - Assistive automation. The system assists an operator.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is providesSupportFor, from must be an Agent

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Availability of a dataset.
A specification type defines the nature of a specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iban
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) is a system for identifying bank accounts across national borders standardized by [ISO 13616](https://www.iso.org/standard/81090.html). It consists of up to 34 alphanumeric characters, including a country code, two check digits, and a basic bank account number. While spaces may be inserted for human readability, they must be omitted when used for electronic data exchange (e.g., `IE64IRCE92050112345678`).
A type of extension consisting of a list of name value pairs.
This is the state of an affected Element at a specific moment in time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Identifies the nature of the `ContactPointRelationship`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to store extra information about an Element which is not part of a review (e.g. extra information provided during the creation of the Element).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).
This property is used to denote the root Element(s) of a tree of elements contained in a BOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: riskAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a risk assessment for a package.
Abstract class representing a license combination consisting of one or more licenses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ocsp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Online Certificate Status Protocol, or OCSP, is a common scheme used to maintain the security of a server and other network resources as defined in [RFC 2560](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc2560/)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: video
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is video based, such as a collection of movie clips.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 256, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: falcon
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [FALCON](https://falcon-sign.info/falcon.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publishedBy
